generation_prompt.prompt: Create a premium {{size}} social media promotional flyer for {{brand_name}}. Style: high-impact sales design — large dominant headline, strong CTA band at the bottom, hero image panel on the right side, and brand accent ribbons. Background: {{color_palette.background}}. Primary accent: {{color_palette.primary}}. Text color: {{color_palette.text}}. Typography: bold uppercase headlines with strong contrast against the background. If a reference sheet is provided, extract each labeled asset and place it in the designated position described below.
generation_prompt.important_instruction: Layout: BRAND LOGO top-center (keep crisp and unmodified, do not stretch), HERO asset fills right panel with a curved {{color_palette.primary}} border on left edge, headline text large and dominant on left side, supporting copy below headline, CTA band across full bottom in {{color_palette.primary}} with {{color_palette.background}} text. Do NOT treat the reference sheet itself as the final design — extract and re-compose each labeled asset into this new layout.
